/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-settings-review-'))
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
files=['README.md','payload.py','client.py','tests/test_payload.py','tests/test_client.py']
manifest={'repository':str(repo),'selector':'git diff --cached','review_base':base,'candidate':'Git index','items':[]}
for role,rev,paths in [('candidate',':',files),('historical',base+':',['payload.py','client.py','tests/test_client.py'])]:
    for name in paths:
        spec=rev+name
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',spec])
        dst=root/role/name
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dst.write_bytes(data)
        dst.chmod(0o444)
        manifest['items'].append({'role':role,'repository':str(repo),'revision':base if role=='historical' else 'index snapshot','original_path':name,'path':str(dst),'blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',spec],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
(root/'selected.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached']))
(root/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(root)
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
PY"
